name: Arctic Cryosphere
region: Svalbard & Greenland Ice Sheet · Polar Tundra
summary: Rapid polar amplification causing ice sheet calving, albedo feedback collapse, and irreversible permafrost methane thawing.

hotspots.title: Tidewater Glacier Calving Margin
hotspots.description: Marine-terminating glacier fronts undergoing warm bottom-water ablation.
hotspots.impactCarryOn: Dynamic ice discharge triples, accelerating global mean sea level contribution beyond 12mm/decade.
hotspots.impactProtect: Ocean warming stabilizes; grounded ice sheet margins preserve stabilizing sea-ice buttresses.

hotspots.title: Continuous Permafrost & Tundra Peatland
hotspots.description: Ancient subterranean carbon reservoir storing double the carbon currently in the atmosphere.
hotspots.impactCarryOn: Widespread thermokarst slumping unlocks gigatons of methane and CO2 into the atmosphere.
hotspots.impactProtect: Revegetation and stabilized polar vortex limit thaw depth to upper active layers.

hotspots.title: Multi-Year Polar Sea Ice Cap
hotspots.description: Earth's giant mirror reflecting solar radiation back into space.
hotspots.impactCarryOn: Ice-free Arctic summers become permanent by 2040, eliminating dark-albedo thermal buffer.
hotspots.impactProtect: Summer sea ice minimum rebounds to >4.5 million sq km, maintaining global jet stream stability.

stats.label: Polar Temp Anomaly

stats.label: Near-Surface Permafrost Thaw
stats.context: Fraction of top 3-meter permafrost volume degraded.

stats.label: Greenland Ice Loss
stats.context: Net annual gigatons of ice melted into surrounding oceans.

carryOn.description: Total disruption of Arctic cryosphere drives planetary tipping cascades, dismantling northern mid-latitude weather patterns.
keyPoints: Summer sea ice disappears completely as early as 2038
Deep permafrost collapse releases massive carbon feedback loops
Displacement of indigenous Arctic communities and polar fauna

protect.description: Rapid decarbonization curbs polar thermal amplification, allowing multi-year sea ice and grounded glaciers to reach equilibrium.
keyPoints: Summer minimum ice cover stabilized above 4 million km²
Protected indigenous stewardship and international polar sanctuaries
Albedo preservation protects global mid-latitude climate stability

sources.title: IPCC Special Report on the Ocean and Cryosphere in a Changing Climate (SROCC)
